subject.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure

question: When the requester turn completes but omits required message-tool evidence, should OpenClaw record a terminal visible-delivery failure immediately, as this head does, rather than consume the existing delivery retry budget?
rationale: Both choices have user-visible consequences: replaying the requester turn can duplicate tools or output, while terminal failure can suppress the completion message after a single omission; repository policy treats fallback and retry behavior as a product contract.

options.title: Confirm Terminal Split
options.body: After rebase and exact-head proof, accept requester wake as successful while recording missing required visible delivery as terminal to prevent requester-turn replay.

options.title: Require Isolated Delivery Retry
options.body: Keep the PR paused until retries can invoke a replay-safe delivery-only operation without rerunning requester reasoning or tools.

options.title: Pause The Change
options.body: Retain current behavior until maintainers define a broader completion-delivery contract that covers requester wake, external sends, retries, and restart recovery.

recommendation.title: Confirm Terminal Split
recommendation.body: After rebase and exact-head proof, accept requester wake as successful while recording missing required visible delivery as terminal to prevent requester-turn replay.
